title: 前副国安顾问Mara Rutman：特朗普为保油价不会重启轰炸
speaker: Mara Rutman

segments.en: I think you've seen I've heard the leaders of major shipping companies within the last 24 hours. I don't know if I saw or heard these quotes today but talking about the risks that they were unwilling to take.
segments.zh: 我想你看到了，我在过去24小时内听到主要航运公司领导人的言论，我不知道我今天是否看到或听到这些引述，但他们谈到不愿承担的风险

segments.en: I think there's going to be a wait and see attitude. I think it will depend on insurers being willing to cover the costs and so President Trump can say that the Strait is open.
segments.zh: 我认为会采取观望态度。这将取决于保险公司是否愿意承保，所以特朗普总统可以说海峡是开放的

segments.en: He's made any number of assertions about this conflict since it started that have been inaccurate and on which he's changed his position within hours.
segments.zh: 自冲突开始以来，他多次做出不准确的断言，并在几小时内改变立场

segments.en: So I could understand how any major shipping company would not base their decision to send cargo through the Strait solely on statements that he's made. So I think there's going to be a fair amount of due diligence that needs to occur before you'll see regular flows of ships through the Strait.
segments.zh: 所以我能理解任何大型航运公司不会仅根据他的声明就决定派船通过海峡。我认为需要进行相当多的尽职调查，才能看到船只定期通过海峡

segments.en: Mara, this is all happening with a lot of criticism from within the US as well. From Republicans, given how this MOU seems to have given around the upper hand, we're getting closer to the midterms.
segments.zh: Mara，这一切在美国国内也受到很多批评。来自共和党人，鉴于这份备忘录似乎让对手占了上风，我们越来越接近中期选举

segments.en: This 60-day negotiation period is also a compressed one as some of our colleagues have highlighted versus the two-year period for the Obama deal. I mean, does that change the calculus, the closer we get to the midterms?
segments.zh: 这个60天谈判期也很紧凑，正如我们一些同事强调的，与奥巴马协议的两年来相比。我的意思是，随着中期选举临近，这会改变计算吗？

segments.en: It would seem that it might, but again, it's an impossible task, I think, to get inside President Trump's head. I think for him, it's difficult sometimes.
segments.zh: 似乎可能，但再次，我认为进入特朗普总统的头脑是不可能的任务。我认为对他来说，有时很难

segments.en: But I think you can look at certainly the comments he made in the press conference within the past 24 hours about his concerns about the economy and not wanting to be another Herbert Hoover, of course, was the President when the United States went into a deep depression.
segments.zh: 但你可以看看他在过去24小时新闻发布会上的评论，他担心经济，不想成为另一个赫伯特·胡佛，胡佛是美国陷入大萧条时的总统

segments.en: So that's clearly front of mind for him. And to be clear, at the same time, he and the Vice President have also said that if Iran doesn't comply, the United States will just start bombing again.
segments.zh: 所以这显然是他最关心的问题。需要明确的是，同时他和副总统也表示，如果伊朗不遵守，美国将再次开始轰炸

segments.en: But if you look at how focused they've been on the price of gasoline and anyone, and certainly oil companies will watch and follow the possibility of the United States starting, restarting the conflict, restarting bombing.
segments.zh: 但如果你看看他们多么关注汽油价格，任何人，当然石油公司会关注美国重启冲突、重启轰炸的可能性
